appendix_mandatory: Full cohort/manifests and provenance hashes for every executed stage.
All preregistered controls and per-layer/per-family summaries needed to reproduce main aggregate claims.
Exact terminal branch logic including null/inconclusive/technical-invalid outcomes.
Engineering-only checks separated from scientific evidence.
Development history/negative expressivity screens clearly labeled as development evidence, not confirmation.
Compute/runtime/storage accounting and all failed direct-baseline fidelity attempts.

claim_boundary.allowed_if_primary_T1_supported: A prospectively identified episode-specific plan-content residual can causally restore/preserve later plan commitment across a real context reset under the frozen model/task scope using exactly one reset-time intervention and persistent no-reinjection continuation, beyond matched plan-specific controls.
claim_boundary.mechanism_only: KV mediation secondary localizes ordinary persistent-KV mediation conditional on supported primary T1; it is not an independent replication.
not_novelty_claims: first state continuity across context turnover
not_supported_without_separate_stage: systems superiority over every memory method

figures.title: ReplayResidual identification and one-shot reset intervention schematic
Untouched causal confirmation: paired first-action-excluded family effects
KV mediation decomposition: TOTAL / PROPAGATED / DIRECT
Systems efficiency Pareto: task/plan outcome versus storage, intervention count, and latency

outcome_invariance.if_sanity_fail: Use same T0 schema; stop ReplayResidual causal descendant; do not hide controls or switch model/benchmark as rescue.
outcome_invariance.if_sanity_inconclusive: Use same T0 schema; report qualification failure; no replacement/rescue under this preregistered experiment.
outcome_invariance.if_sanity_pass: Use same T0 schema and advance only via frozen T1 dependency.
outcome_invariance.if_technical_invalid: Report exact violated guard; technical invalidity is not scientific support/refutation.

purpose: Predeclare paper tables, figures, terminal outcomes, and claim boundaries before inspecting the canonical V2.1 representation-sanity result.
reporting_principles: Report every prospectively frozen primary metric and gate regardless of direction.
Never select layers, families, controls, scales, plots, or endpoints by post-outcome visual appeal.
Keep development, untouched confirmation, replication, mechanistic secondary, systems comparison, and external-validity evidence in separate columns/sections and never pool them.
A null, inconclusive, or technical-invalid stage remains explicitly reportable and cannot be hidden by a later model/benchmark switch.
No systems/generalization result may rescue a null primary causal result.

T0_representation_sanity.population: fixed ALFWorld train pick_and_place_simple development indices 0..31; no replacement; minimum final qualified 16
T0_representation_sanity.primary_metric: family_aggregate_margin = median over frozen layers of same_plan_temporal_cosine minus max frozen control cosine
T0_representation_sanity.scope_note: PASS is representation feasibility only, never causal T1 support.

T1_primary_causal_confirmation.claim_scope: Episode-specific plan-residual causal sufficiency across a real reset with exactly one intervention and first-action-excluded multi-step continuation.
T1_primary_causal_confirmation.population: all fixed untouched primary confirmation families; retain conservative nonpositive handling for unqualified/unconstructible cases per preregistration
T1_primary_causal_confirmation.selection: global development-only operating point; frozen before any untouched-confirmation request; no per-family tuning
T1_primary_causal_confirmation.statistics: Family is independent unit; exact one-sided sign/binomial tests; zeros/ties nonpositive; frozen Holm FWER 0.05 and numerical/task/valid-action guards.

T2_replication.rule: Report original n=12 no-retuning robustness replication separately from any later additional n=20 reserve; never pool with primary confirmation or with each other.

T3_KV_mediation.control_rule: For each cache arm separately, subtract D_FULL_RESTORE and compare PLAN to max of NEXT_ACTION_PRESERVED_LATE_NULL, UNRELATED_PLAN, EQUAL_NORM_RANDOM; never pool controls across arms.
T3_KV_mediation.engineering_guard_note: 1e-6 is a preregistered sham/clean numerical-equivalence engineering guard only; never a scientific effect threshold.

T4_systems_baselines.fairness: Same backbone/revision/runtime/cohort/environment/evaluator/action budget wherever direct adaptation is feasible.
positioning_only: StateBridge unless faithful direct adaptation exists
persistent-Q4-KV unless faithful direct adaptation exists
TransMem public-release reproduction kept separate from same-task systems table unless protocol becomes directly matched

T5_external_validity.interpretation: Failure narrows generalization; it does not rewrite a valid within-scope primary result.
